article.headline: Bryson Dawkins scores 17 to lead Houston Christian over Incarnate Word 81-76
article.description: — Bryson Dawkins had 17 points in Houston Christian's 81-76 victory over Incarnate Word on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Bryson Dawkins scores 17 to lead Houston Christian over Incarnate Word 81-76
article.story: HOUSTON -- — Bryson Dawkins had 17 points in Houston Christian's 81-76 victory over Incarnate Word on Saturday night. Dawkins added six rebounds for the Huskies (6-10, 3-2 Southland Conference). Julian Mackey had 16 points and Elijah Brooks scored 15. Jordan Pyke finished with 27 points and seven rebounds to pace the Cardinals (9-7, 2-3). Dylan Hayman added 19 points and two blocks. Davion Bailey scored nine. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
